messages:
marta (sec-lead): scheduling a targeted pen test with RedTeamCo on 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Scope: read-only evidence pulls, one KMS decrypt key, and object-level audit proof. planning a 30m dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00. @tess @pranav advise on RBAC/KMS. cc @jon for logs retention.

Tess (eng-sre): prefer ephemeral assume-role in our account. we'll limit session to 1h and deny write actions. will also enable S3 server access logs + CloudTrail data events for object GETs.

Pranav (infra): KMS plan: create a one-off Grant scoped to the assessor role with EncryptionContext constraint {"evidence-origin":"redteamco"}. log grant id and auto-revoke after the engagement. will test in staging by 2026-03-30.

Jon (platform): telemetry asks: forward CloudTrail data events to locked archive bucket (MFA-delete) and set CloudWatch Logs retention 365d for pt groups. ensure object-level entries can be tied to assume-role sessions.

Tess (eng-sre): sample policy ready; will add explicit Deny for prefixes: /models/* and /generated/* so assessors can't read runtime artifacts. posting trimmed policy in dry-run.

Marta (sec-lead): legal note: no plaintext or key escrow. require signed vendor principal and CSR for trust binding. action items: pranav create grant+role in staging (due 3/30), tess run pre-dry-run checklist (due 3/31), jon enable data events & logs (due 3/31). I'll upload vendor principals today.

Audit-bot: automated note - CloudTrail data events will be enabled for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence and archived for 395 days.
